title: Rich McKay: No proposal to ban it, but tush push still has some people concerned

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Rich McKay: No proposal to ban it, but tush push still has some people concerned
sources.description: The NFL is not currently considering any proposals to ban the tush push, but Competition Committee Co-Chairman Rich McKay says the legality of the play could continue to be the subject of discussions around the league.
